40006350.author: पदार्थः
40006350.content: भरते Bharata, प्रतिप्रयाते had departed, रामः Rama, तपोवने in the grove of ascetics, अथ then, तपस्विनाम् of ascetics, सोद्वेगम् filled with apprehension, औत्सुक्यम् eagerness (with intense desire to leave that forest), लक्षयामास observed.

40006350.author: Translation
40006350.content: After Bharta, had departed, Rama who was living in the penancegrove of ascetics observed that the ascetics were filled with apprehensions, and were eager (to leave that forest).

40006351.author: पदार्थः
40006351.content: तत्र there, पुरस्तात् in front of, चित्रकूटस्य of Chitrakuta, तापसाश्रमे in the hermitage, रामम् Rama, आश्रित्य sought his protection, निरताः intent on staying, तान् them, उत्सुकान् anxious, अलक्षयत् observed.

40006351.author: Translation
40006351.content: Rama observed that the sages who earlier sought to stay with him near his hermitage under his protection on chitrakuta were filled with anxiety (now).

40006352.author: पदार्थः
40006352.content: शङ्किताः suspicious, नयनैः with eyes, भृकुटीभिश्च by knitting their eyebrows, रामम् of Rama, निर्दिश्य glancing, अन्योन्यम् to each other, उपजल्पन्तः conversing, मिथः mutually, कथाः incidents, चक्रुः narrated.

40006352.author: Translation
40006352.content: Those sages, glancing at Rama with suspicious eyes, knitting their eyebrows and murmering among themselves, conversed secretly.

40006353.author: पदार्थः
40006353.content: ततः then, रामस्तु as for Rama, तेषाम् their, औत्सुक्यम् anxiety, आलक्ष्य having observed, स्या स्वात्मनि in his mind, शङ्कितः suspecting, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms in reverence,  कुलपतिम् the chief of the hermitage, ऋषिम् that sage, इदम् these words, उवाच said.

40006353.author: Translation
40006353.content: Having observed their anxiety, Rama apprehending somethig in his mind approached  the chief of the hermitage with folded palms and said:

40006354.author: पदार्थः
40006354.content: भगवत् O revered one, मयि in me, पूर्ववृत्तम् earlier conduct, किञ्चित् nothing, इदम् this, विकृतम् change, न दृश्यते कच्चित् not noticed, येन by what, तपस्विनः sages, विक्रियन्ते are perturbed.

40006354.author: Translation
40006354.content: O revered sire, have you seen any change in my conduct? For what reason are the sages looking perturbed?

40006355.author: पदार्थः
40006355.content: मे अवरजस्य my younger brother's, लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, प्रमादात् through inadvertance, आत्मनः himself, नानुरूपं unbefitting, चरितम् conduct, ऋषिभिः by sages, दृष्टं कच्चित् has  been seen.

40006355.author: Translation
40006355.content: Have the sages found my younger brother Lakshmana doing something unbecoming of him through inadvertence?

40006356.author: पदार्थः
40006356.content: वः to you, शुश्रूषमाणा engaged in serving, मयि in me, शुश्रूषणपरा devoted to service, सीता by Sita, प्रमदाभ्युचिताम् befitting a woman, वृत्तिम् conduct, युक्तम् properly, न वर्तते कच्छित् is not following.

40006356.author: Translation
40006356.content: Has Sita devoted in her service to me and engaged in serving you failed to follow the conduct befitting a woman?

40006357.author: पदार्थः
40006357.content: अथ then, जरया in old age, वृद्धः grown old, तपसा च also in austerities, जराम् old age, गतः attained, ऋषिः ascetic, वेपमान इव as though trembling, भूतदयापरम् compassionate to all beings, रामम्  to Rama, उवाच said.

40006357.author: Translation
40006357.content: Hearing those words, an ascetic old in age and austerities, as though trembling said  to Rama who is compassionate to all beings:

40006358.author: पदार्थः
40006358.content: तात O dear child, कल्याणसत्त्वायाः of a lady of auspicious nature, तथा also, कल्याणाभिरतेः  ever engaged in performing auspicious deeds, वैदेह्याः Sita's, चलनम् violation of duty, विशेषतः especially, तपस्विषु in respect of ascetics, कुतः how ?

40006358.author: Translation
40006358.content: O dear child, how can goodnatured Sita who is always engaged in performing auspicious deeds, especially towards ascetics be associated with violation of duty?

40006359.author: पदार्थः
40006359.content: त्वन्निमित्तम् for your sake, रक्षोभ्यः on account of  rakshasas, तापसान् to ascetics, इदम् this fear, प्रतिवर्तते तावत् is arising, तेन by that, संविग्नाः they are scared, मिथ: mutually, कथाः incidents, कथयन्ति are exchanging.

40006359.author: Translation
40006359.content: There is apprehension for ascetics from the demons on acount of your presence here. That is why they are conversing with one another about the likely fallout.

40006360.author: पदार्थः
40006360.content: तात O dear child, इह here, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, धृष्टश्च impudent, जितकाशी च appearing victorious, नृशंसः cruel one, पुरुषादकः cannibal, अवलिप्तश्च haughty, पापश्च a sinner, खरो नाम by name Khara, जनस्थाननिकेतनान् residents of 'Janasthanam', सर्वान् all, तापसान् ascetics, उत्पाट्य having uprooted, त्वां च you also, न मृष्यते will not pardon.

40006360.author: Translation
40006360.content: O dear child, Khara, one of the brothers of Ravana is dwelling in nearby 'Janasthana'. He is impudent, reportedly winner of battles, cruel, sinful, a maneater and haughty. He has uprooted all the ascetics  from Janasthana. He will not tolerate even you.

40006361.author: पदार्थः
40006361.content: तात O dear child, इह here, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, धृष्टश्च impudent, जितकाशी च appearing victorious, नृशंसः cruel one, पुरुषादकः cannibal, अवलिप्तश्च haughty, पापश्च a sinner, खरो नाम by name Khara, जनस्थाननिकेतनान् residents of 'Janasthanam', सर्वान् all, तापसान् ascetics, उत्पाट्य having uprooted, त्वां च you also, न मृष्यते will not pardon.

40006361.author: Translation
40006361.content: O dear child, Khara, one of the brothers of Ravana is dwelling in nearby 'Janasthana'. He is impudent, reportedly winner of battles, cruel, sinful, a maneater and haughty. He has uprooted all the ascetics  from Janasthana. He will not tolerate even you.

40006362.author: पदार्थः
40006362.content: तात O dear child, त्वम् you, यदाप्रभृति from the time, अस्मिन् आश्रमे in this hermitage, वर्तसे started residing, तदाप्रभृति since that time, रक्षांसि rakshasas, तापसान् the ascetics, विप्रकुर्वन्ति are tormenting.

40006362.author: Translation
40006362.content: O dear child, ever since you started residing in this hermitage rakshasas have been  tormenting the ascetics.

40006363.author: पदार्थः
40006363.content: बीभत्सैः in distorted appearance, क्रूरैः by cruel, भीषणकैरपि by frightening, नानारूपैः in various forms, विरूपैश्च by deformaed appearance, विकृतदर्शनैः detestable looks, रूपैः in forms, दर्शयन्ति they exhibit.

40006363.author: Translation
40006363.content: They appear in various distorted forms now rapacious, now fearful, now deformed.

40006364.author: पदार्थः
40006364.content: अनार्याः the wicked rakshasas, पुरतः in front of, स्थिताः standing, तापसान् ascetics, अप्रशस्तै: forbidden, अशुचिभिः dirty things, सम्प्रयोज्य employing, अपरान् some other ascetics, प्रतिघ्नन्ति are killing.

40006364.author: Translation
40006364.content: Those wicked rakshasas employ forbidden and dirty means against ascetics and kill them by suddenly appearing in front of them.

40006365.author: पदार्थः
40006365.content: अल्पचेतसः debased ones, तेषु तेषु in different, स्थानेषु in ashram sites, अबुद्धम् without being perceived, अवलीय च after concealing themselves, तत्र there, तापसान् the ascetics, नाशयन्तः while destroying, रमन्ते are taking delight.

40006365.author: Translation
40006365.content: These debased rakshasas, concealing themselves in various ashram sites take delight  in harassing and killing the ascetics.

40006366.author: पदार्थः
40006366.content: हवने the sacrifices, समुपस्थिते are about to commence, स्रुग्भाण्डान् the sacrificial ladels and vessels containing sacrificial materials, अवक्षिपन्ति throw away, वारिणा with water, अग्नीन्    the fire for oblation, सिञ्चन्ति are drenching, कलशांश्च waterpots, प्रमदेन्तीध्नन्ति destroy.

40006366.author: Translation
40006366.content: When sacrifices are about to start, they throw away the sacrificial ladels and vessels containing sacrificial materials and sprinkle water on sacrificial fire. They also break down the earthen vessels used in the sacrifice.

40006367.author: पदार्थः
40006367.content: अद्य now, ऋषयः sages, दुरात्मभिः by those beings of wicked nature, तैः by those rakshasas, अमृष्टान् infested with, आश्रमान् the hermitages, प्रजिहासवः those who want to flee, अन्यदेशस्य to another region, गमनाय to go, माम् me, चोदयन्ति are urging.

40006367.author: Translation
40006367.content: Now all these sages are urging me to abandon this hermitage infested by these wicked rakshasas and move to another region.

40006368.author: पदार्थः
40006368.content: राम O Rama, ते दुष्टाः those vile creatures, तपस्विषु to these sages, शारीराम् physical, उपहिंसाम् violence, पुरा दर्शयन्ति हि they show in the begining, तत् for that reason, इमम् आश्रमम् this ashram, त्यक्ष्यामः we are going to quit.

40006368.author: Translation
40006368.content: O Rama, those vile creatures resort to physical violence against ascetics, we have therefore, resolved to quit this ashram.

40006369.author: पदार्थः
40006369.content: इतः from here, अविदूरात् not very far, बहुमूलफलम् abounding in roots and fruits, चित्रम् वनम् lovely woods, अहम् I, पुनः again, सगणः with my companions, पुराणाश्रममेव the ancient ashram, श्रयिष्ये I will seek shelter.

40006369.author: Translation
40006369.content: Not very far from here stands an ancient ashram in a lovely forest abounding in roots and fruits and I with my companions will seek shelter there.

40006370.author: पदार्थः
40006370.content: तात O dear child, खरः Khara, त्वय्यपि च with you also, अयुक्तम् improperly, पुरा प्रवर्तते   behaves at the outset, बुद्धि: प्रवर्तते यदि if you so like, इतः from here, अस्माभिः सह along with us, गच्छ you may go.

40006370.author: Translation
40006370.content: Dear child, Khara will also misbehave with you as usual. (Therefore), if you so decide you may come along with us.

40006371.author: पदार्थः
40006371.content: राघव O Rama, नित्यम् always, यत्तस्य since for a man, समर्थस्यापि हि सतः even though capable, सकलत्रस्य a man accompanied by his wife, ते to you, सन्देहः doubtful, अद्य now, इह here, वासः living, दुःखम् is painful.

40006371.author: Translation
40006371.content: O Rama, even though you are always vigilant and capable in all possible ways to defend youself, a doubt arises in our mind. It is perilous for you to live here with your wife.

40006372.author: पदार्थः
40006372.content: राजपुत्रः son of a king, राम Rama, इति thus, उक्तवन्तम् saying this, समुत्सुकम् anxious, तं तपस्विनम् that sage, उत्तरैः in the form of a reply, वाक्यैः by words, अवरोद्धुम् to hold him back, न शशाक was unable.

40006372.author: Translation
40006372.content: It was not possible for prince Rama to hold back by mere words that ascetic who was saying like this and was anxious to quit the hermitage.

40006373.author: पदार्थः
40006373.content: सः कुलपतिः that chief of ascetics, राघवम् to Rama, अभिनन्द्य having greeted, समापृच्छ्य  having taken leave, समाधाय having convinced, कुलैस्सह along with his group, आश्रमम् hermitage, त्यक्त्वा after abandoning, जगाम  went.

40006373.author: Translation
40006373.content: The leader of the group quit the hermitage along with his companions after paying  respect to Rama, convincing him and taking leave of him.

40006374.author: पदार्थः
40006374.content: रामः Rama, तस्मात् देशात् from that region, अनुगमनात् by following them for some distance, ऋषिगणम् the sages, संसाध्य bidding them farewell, कुलपतिम् chief of the groups, ऋषिम् that sage, अभिवाद्य having paid obeisance, सम्यक् properly, प्रीतैः by the pleased, तैः by them, अनुमतः having been consented, उपदिष्टार्थः having grasped their instruction, वासाय to reside, पुण्यम् holy, स्वं निलयम् his own hermitage, उपसम्पेदे approached.

40006374.author: Translation
40006374.content: Rama, followed the sages for some distance to bid them farewell. He paid obeisance to the chief of the group and having grasped the instruction of the highly pleased  sages, he with their consent returned to his holy hermitage.

40006375.author: पदार्थः
40006375.content: प्रभुः the lord, सः राघवः that Rama, ऋषिविरहितम् deserted by the sages, आश्रमम् hermitage, क्षणमपि for a moment also, न जहौ did not leave, आर्षचरिते following the tradition of sages, धृतगुणाः fixed in many virtues, तापसाश्च even the sages, सततम् always, राघवम् to Rama, अनुगताः हि followed remained.

40006375.author: Translation
40006375.content: Lord Rama, did not leave that hermitage deserted by the sages even for a moment. Those who had adopted the traditions of the sages and  had acquired many virtues followed Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षोडशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredsixteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
